data.description: Native `<video>` lazy loader. Defers source loading until the element scrolls into view. Use child `<source data-src='...'>` elements (note the `data-src`, not `src`) for the actual URLs.
Click-to-play iframe facade for hosted players. Renders a poster image with a play button; the real iframe loads only on click.

data-aed-video-title.description: Optional accessible title for the facade and resulting iframe.

data-aed-video-poster.description: Poster image URL. YouTube auto-fetches `hqdefault.jpg` if omitted.

data-aed-video-start.description: YouTube start time (e.g. '90' for 1m30s into the video).
